I had a short stay at Chivitr, and it truly felt like stepping into another world. The Tibetan sound therapy was an incredible experience, and K.Sam was very professional.

Chivitr is more than a wellness retreat—it feels like a place that renews life. The warm hospitality of Khun Or made me feel at home, and their personalized programs are perfect for any guest looking for a unique and meaningful wellness experience.❤️👍

I had an incredible experience at this alternative health center! The electro-therapy massage was highly effective, helping to cleanse my lymphocytes and target my nerves with a top-quality massage. The owner is absolutely charming, highly skilled, and offers a wide range of personalized treatments. The place is a true slice of paradise, with breathtaking architecture that enhances the overall experience. Highly recommended for anyone seeking unique and restorative care!

Chivtr is a healing place like no other.  Like a precious gem set against a hill overlooking a vast pond, this artfully built oriental-inspired estate is a private and luxurious enclave for healing and rejuvenating tired bodies, minds and souls.

My experience with the owner, Or, and her staff were second to none on the several treatments I had for my eczema outbreak.  The atmosphere is professional, warm and calm from beginning to end.  Within one or two treatments, the flare subsided substantially.  Or was kind enough to even cook some of the most delicious and healthy dishes that I will never forget.

Chivitr is a dream home away from home where you can stay for a few days or drop-in for the best care, programmes and treatments to heal and rejuvenate holistically.

This place is amazing. The design of the hotel is a piece of art, with great interior both in the rooms and on the territory of the hotel. l had a holistic massage with oil there, it was heaven. The staff are amazing people.

Healing and Luxury at Chivitr, Phuket

After more than a year of unsuccessful treatments in Hamburg - in clinics, with orthopedists, and physiotherapists, using a variety of medications and painkillers - I finally found relief at Chivitr in Phuket. The team applied traditional Chinese and Thai medicine such as massage, acupuncture, and cupping, which alleviated at least 70% of my elbow and shoulder pain. A few months later, I am delighted to report a complete recovery.

Beyond the exceptional medical care, Chivitr itself is a fantastic place. The architecture is stunning, blending luxury with traditional elements. Its location near one of Phuket's most beautiful beaches makes it an ideal holiday destination. I highly recommend staying here and would like to extend my deepest thanks to Or and the entire team.

An unearthed gem in the hills of Phuket- an incredible resort, only eclipsed by their team and their unwavering dedication and care.

Stumbled across this via the web for ELT, but it took me down avenues of improving health, nutrition and encompassing an overall lifestyle change.

The attention to detail, sincere warmth and personal one-to-one care is unrivalled. Can't recommend a visit here to Dr Or and her team highly enough.

Fantastic experience.

I recommend to visit this place if you are the one who focus on a healthy body, peaceful mind and great spirit.
It's a place where I can be surrounded by true natural of this island. It takes 10 minutes walk to Nai Harn beach or private outdoor salt-chlorinated 27 m. lap pool. Also close by the famous hilltop viewpoint for the sunset, Promthep Cape.
The staff are friendly and empathety. So you will lucky get energy impacting body ,mind and soul.

I’ve been here twice, but my second time was extremely disappointing. Here is why.
I came with my bf for a nice massage one morning and there was no masseuse at that moment. The place was empty. So, what they did is they called 2 random masseuse from the street and it was the worst massage we ever had.
By the way, for this kind of service we paid a full price which was 1500THB/per person.
It’s up to you to decide, but for us its unacceptable.

A secret hotel that doesnt show on any Agoda or Booking.com
It’s totally well-designed by the owner herself.
Breakfast was very healthy and delicious.
Staff is super nice.
Their spa & treatments are the best.
Most importantly, the hospitality oversees by the owner, K’Or, herself was beyond our expectation.

Comments speak for themselves, but I wanted to add one more!

We stayed at the resort and had a remarkable, healing, and lovely time. The rooms are gorgeous, they offer a broad array of treatment (massage, ELT, sound therapy, water/float therapy and more) and they are really well done. It's a very high level of service and care. Treatments were incredible and they'll personalize a plan for your stay. Thank you to the staff and shoutout to Or!

If you're coming to Phuket looking for wellness with overnight stays then this is a world class option.

This place is very unique and there is nothing like it anywhere. I would rate it 10 stars, if I could.  It is a result of 10 years of work by the owner, every single detail from rain water collection system to every single piece of furniture that was custom designed and made from the finest materials, design fabrics, teak wooden floors, 128 antique wooden doors, all appliances, salt water pools reflect love and passion for excellence and creativity that is second to none. There are   only 8 units and they're all unique in style , art work, size and decor located around a big pool. Property is elevated over the sea level and there is always a pleasant breeze making guests comfortable even in the middle of hot day. I came as a guest and I left my heart there longing for return..

Each suite is furnished with impeccable taste, every detail is carefully considered, nothing is left to chance. You come here to be reborn, the treatments are designed by professionals. A unique high-class resort with 11 rooms and exclusive therapy options. The carefully selected hotel style, the rooms, and the spa are impeccably clean and a blend of traditional and modern. The therapists and the owner are professional, friendly, and very attentive. I highly recommend the signature treatments and the Watsu treatments. Chivitr is a gem in southern Phuket for those seeking quality, sustainability, and professional Far Eastern healing (Traditional Chinese Medicine & Traditional Chinese Medicine). Guests will not only find what they're looking for here but will be more than pleasantly surprised by the diversity of Chivitr Wellness. Thank you, my top address in Phuket.

An incredibly beautiful place, where you find peace of mind. My girlfriend and I took Watsu and it was a very meditative experience. The people who work there and the owner provide extremely good service. Next time we will stay here for a few nights!

Luxurious! I booked a duplex for my parents for two weeks. The grounds themselves are beautifully appointed and of exceptional quality. Everything is beautiful and well-maintained. You can spend hours exploring the interiors and discovering …

I recall with great delight and sincere gratitude our two-week vacation at the boutique hotel our daughter found and booked for us. The 10-room hotel allowed us to rest and relax. During our entire stay, we only met another guest once. The huge pool in front of the Water Villa was entirely ours. The hotel offered a wide range of wellness programs, massages, and spa treatments, which we, of course, took advantage of and left feeling recharged and emotionally charged. There are places to connect with nature, practice yoga, and a healthy breakfast delivered to your room. Chivitr is our place of power and our secret place in Phuket.
